output: I keep wondering if there’s a way to stop flinching every time it shows up, like it’s a signal I can’t ignore. Maybe if I stop treating it like an enemy, it won’t feel so loud and inescapable. But then again, it’s hard not to feel like it’s trying to tell me something I don’t want to hear.
